Decision #332; one implementation PR; Task Size M.

PDF77 all nine slot columns from exact Wizard row; Long Rest restores all. Class level selects slots; PB/XP uses complete admitted canonical total level. Positive Wizard1 total5 has2 level1 slots PB3; reject total5 Wizard slots or bool/fractional/total21/class>total.

Prepare is inert, without dice or writes. Authoritative confirmation revalidates actor, campaign, source version, entitlement, revision, targets, action, timing and costs. Persist injected dice, choices, resources, derived sheet and public history atomically in isolated PostgreSQL. Same-ID retry/reload/reconnect returns the saved receipt; conflicting payload, stale and foreign state reject. Race two confirmations: one commit. Inject cost/effect/history failure: full rollback. Shared engine availability and unavailable reasons agree on web and trusted TUI; test confirmation, cancellation and reconnect, desktop/phone behavior, build and changed-file lint. Passive effects belong to their triggering confirmed event. No private HP, targets or lore disclosure. Unknown execution stays unavailable. No production admission, inference, deployment or Full Rules promotion. CC-BY-4.0 attribution and adaptation: docs/srd-5.2.1-conformance.md.
